test.command: cd backend && mvn test; cd frontend && npm test

blockingIssues.description: WebSocket handshake auth falls back to default user 1 when X-User-Id is missing/invalid, so unauthenticated connections are accepted instead of rejected (violates VAL-WS-011).

appliedUpdates.description: Documented WebSocket auth nuance in .factory/library/architecture.md: backend user identity is set from SockJS/HTTP handshake headers, not STOMP CONNECT headers.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify fake-auth expectations for WebSocket separately from HTTP defaults: if a milestone requires rejecting unauthenticated WebSocket clients, default-user fallback must not be applied in handshake interceptors.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: websocket-backend review found DEFAULT_USER_ID fallback in WebSocketAuthInterceptor accepted missing/invalid auth headers and caused a blocking validation failure.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Relax strict TDD-first requirement for UI-heavy asynchronous behavior (debounce/timers/toggles) to allow implementation-first with immediate test backfill when red-first setup is impractical.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: search-filters-frontend-ui review and handoff skillFeedback both indicate TDD red phase was impractical, but final test coverage and validators were still strong.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Make procedure adherence checks explicit for manual validation and shared-library updates (or mark those steps optional with criteria), and require accurate skillFeedback when steps are skipped.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: websocket-frontend review observed no agent-browser/manual verification and no library update despite skill steps requiring both and handoff marking followedProcedure=true.

rejectedObservations.observation: Update .factory/library/architecture.md on every incremental frontend change.
frontend-worker procedure mismatch observations from search-filters-frontend-ui and websocket-frontend reviews
